tips.text: Buy the Slaytra first if you want it early; every Chipper item draws from the same Stock pool.
Do not count the Machete you carry in Sneaky Sabotage as owning the weapon; it only borrows the name.
Expect one mission run in your first Garrison week plus 8 Tellurium; the Slaytra is one of Chipper's cheapest items.
Expect to dislike Kahl missions: the collectibles, his slow movement and forced solo play draw the most complaints.
